status: First harmonisation pass complete; legacy site recovery in progress
question: Which human OXTR binding elements and regional evidence are reported, where are they located, and which records overlap or reuse evidence?

categories.label: Laboratory tested
categories.definition: The record reports a laboratory assay. Includes positive, mixed and negative results; a group-level test does not resolve every member.

categories.label: Binding evidence
categories.definition: Reported DNA binding or regional occupancy, at the resolution and in the system stated by the source.

categories.label: Functional evidence
categories.definition: An element, region or element-based reporter has an experimental regulatory response. This does not imply every nucleotide or predicted motif was independently validated.

categories.label: Annotation or prediction
categories.definition: Sequence or database annotation; direct binding is not established by the annotation alone.

categories.label: Regulatory context
categories.definition: Evidence concerning gene regulation without an independently resolved binding site in this record.

coordinate_system: GRCh38, 0-based start and exclusive end. Historical TSS/ATG/CpG positions retained verbatim until anchored.
normalisation: Common columns and stable identifiers. Original source records remain unchanged. Source scores retain their own scales; missing values remain null.
deduplication: Group exact intervals by species, assembly, chromosome, start and end. Preserve all observations, strands, factors and experiments. Interval identity is not biological-site identity.
overlap_scope: Mapped human literature records versus imported ENCODE, ORegAnno, JASPAR and screened BrainTF observations. Not an all-pairs motif network. Prediction display-threshold flags are retained.
species_policy: Human and animal observations remain distinguishable; no cross-species deduplication or coordinate projection.
atlas_status: No DNA-to-M9 mapping or statistical comparison performed. Native positions remain the basis for future defined comparisons.

original_fifteen.status: Full-text tables and figures still required
original_fifteen.evidence: Human promoter study reports computer analysis, EMSA and mutation assays; effects differ by factor and combination.
